_about: Set "version" to make every Manifexus install that version within about 15 minutes, back or forward, whatever its update settings say (for example "3.4"). While it's set, ordinary updates wait, so servers stay on it. Set it back to null to let updates resume. It can't go back before 3.4, nor before a version marked "storageChange" in release-notes.json. "message" (optional) is shown to people in Updates. ACTIVE ROLLOUT (2026-10-26): Version 3.6 is developer-enforced until the owner has identified the second server. Keep the discovery message unchanged while waiting for the check-in; clearing version resumes ordinary updates.
